CNII: Greater than 6 months nursing experience

Under the direction of the Directors of the Brain Tumor Program (BTP), also known as the Brain Tumor Integrated Practice Unit, you will provide care coordination, continuity of care, follow-up, support, and education for patients of the Brain Tumor Program and their families. In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact for all patients in the Brain Tumor Program and will be primarily responsible for coordinating care between patients, their families, and the Multidisciplinary Cancer Care Team. You will also help guide brain tumor patients through their cancer care experience.
BSN or MSN required for all new hires effective 1/1/2015, current UCLA Health employees may be exempt.
Ability to complete a Nursing physical assessment
Skill in developing a plan of care including setting goals, monitoring and documenting progress
Ability to implement interventions that are pertinent to goals established in the plan of care
Ability to evaluate the effective of interventions toward the attainment of established goals and to recognize the need to reassess or reset goal parameters
Ability to delegate tasks in a management style that is consistent with promoting leadership and teamwork
Knowledge base to provide education to patients, families, and other staff regarding clinical and patient care issues
